Q: How to properly update product variant metafields with Shopify REST API (sub-collections use case)? A:

You cannot update variant metafields through the product endpoint.
Each product variant has its own metafields, and they must be created or updated directly on the variant using the REST API.

Correct REST API endpoint (variant-level)

To create a metafield on a variant:

POST /admin/api/2024-01/variants/{VARIANT_ID}/metafields.json

To update an existing metafield:

PUT /admin/api/2024-01/metafields/{METAFIELD_ID}.json

{
  "metafield": {
    "namespace": "custom",
    "key": "sub_color",
    "type": "single_line_text_field",
    "value": "Red"
  }
}

Example payload

  1. {VARIANT_ID} must be the variant ID, not the product ID

  2. namespace + key must be unique per variant

  3. type must match the metafield definition

What does NOT work

  • Updating variant metafields via /products/{id}.json

  • Trying to batch-update variant metafields through the product payload

  • Mixing GraphQL metafield syntax with REST

  • Omitting the variant ID

Each variant metafield must be handled individually.
